description: State and refresh plans across an early-Fajr night, a polar gap, a missing Isha, a disabled high-latitude rule and an ordinary day.

vectors.description: stateChanges from 20:00 on 06-19 to 04:00 on 06-20 in Kazan: Maghrib's approach (20:17), Maghrib (20:32) and its just-started end (20:47), the approach of Isha and of 06-20's Fajr (23:30), the two events at 23:45, the end of Fajr's just-started window at midnight, and sunrise (02:58). The entry at 23:45 already has 06-20's Fajr as previous.
vectors.provenance: RFC 0001 §4.8 (transitions, dates, lookahead bound start(civil(e) + 2)); RFC 0001 §4.3 rule 4, §4.6 (context reads civil(b + lead)), §10 #1; RFC 0002 §4.4; instants from SalahTimes' Python reference (SalahTimes 0.1.0, Vectors/reference/salahtimes_reference.py)

vectors.description: stateChanges from 12:00 on 06-21 to 18:00 on 06-22 at Tromsø in polar day: unavailable until Dhuhr, available from Dhuhr through Asr, unavailable again from Asr (17:58) until 06-22's Dhuhr, and the same pattern on 06-22. Entries carry the polar windows as gaps.
vectors.provenance: RFC 0001 §4.8 (transitions, dates, lookahead bound start(civil(e) + 2)); RFC 0002 §4.2, §4.3 step 4 (doesNotOccur); RFC 0002 §4.5; instants from SalahTimes' Python reference (SalahTimes 0.1.0, Vectors/reference/salahtimes_reference.py)

vectors.description: stateChanges from 06:00 to 18:00 on 12-21 at Tromsø in polar night: Fajr's approach and Fajr, after which previous is null (sunrise's window opens) while latestPrayer and nextPrayer stay known; Dhuhr starts an unavailable span (Asr and Maghrib missing) that ends at Isha (16:44).
vectors.provenance: RFC 0001 §4.8 (transitions, dates, lookahead bound start(civil(e) + 2)); RFC 0002 §4.2, §4.3 step 4 (doesNotOccur); RFC 0002 §4.5; instants from SalahTimes' Python reference (SalahTimes 0.1.0, Vectors/reference/salahtimes_reference.py)

vectors.description: stateChanges from 22:00 on 06-01 to 04:00 on 06-02 at 66.5° N: Maghrib's approach and Maghrib (00:24), from which 06-01's missing Isha leaves the state unavailable until 06-02's Fajr (01:51), then sunrise.
vectors.provenance: RFC 0001 §4.8 (transitions, dates, lookahead bound start(civil(e) + 2)); RFC 0002 §4.2, §4.3 step 3 (the earlier day gives way); RFC 0001 §4.3 rule 6, §9 #3; instants from SalahTimes' Python reference (SalahTimes 0.1.0, Vectors/reference/salahtimes_reference.py)

vectors.description: stateChanges from 21:00 on 06-21 to 06:00 on 06-22 in Oslo with the rule disabled: Maghrib's approach and Maghrib (22:44), then an unavailable night until sunrise (03:54), when previous is sunrise and latestPrayer is still unknown (the night's windows hold prayers).
vectors.provenance: RFC 0001 §4.8 (transitions, dates, lookahead bound start(civil(e) + 2)); RFC 0002 §4.2, §4.3 step 4 (doesNotOccur); RFC 0002 §4.5; instants from SalahTimes' Python reference (SalahTimes 0.1.0, Vectors/reference/salahtimes_reference.py)

vectors.description: stateChanges from 21:00 on 06-21 to 06:00 on 06-22 in Kashgar: Maghrib (22:27), the approach of 06-21's Isha (00:04) and Isha itself at 00:19 on 06-22, then 06-22's Fajr (05:28).
vectors.provenance: RFC 0001 §4.8 (transitions, dates, lookahead bound start(civil(e) + 2)); RFC 0002 §4.2, §4.3; instants from SalahTimes' Python reference (SalahTimes 0.1.0, Vectors/reference/salahtimes_reference.py)

vectors.description: stateChanges over the whole of 2026-10-13 in Makkah with limit 8: the day has 17 dates, so the plan keeps the first 7 and is valid until the 8th, the end of Dhuhr's just-started window (12:22).
vectors.provenance: RFC 0001 §4.8 (transitions, dates, lookahead bound start(civil(e) + 2)), budget; RFC 0002 §4.2, §4.3; instants from SalahTimes' Python reference (SalahTimes 0.1.0, Vectors/reference/salahtimes_reference.py)

vectors.description: State at 21:00 on 06-19 in Kazan with the default bound: next is 06-19's Isha (23:45); 06-20's Fajr, at the same instant, is upcoming, not next.
vectors.provenance: RFC 0001 §4.7; RFC 0001 §4.3 rule 4, §4.6 (context reads civil(b + lead)), §10 #1; RFC 0002 §4.4; instants from SalahTimes' Python reference (SalahTimes 0.1.0, Vectors/reference/salahtimes_reference.py)

vectors.description: State at 01:00 GMT on 10-25 in London, inside the repeated hour after the clocks went back: previous is 10-24's Isha (19:21 BST), next 10-25's Fajr (05:09 GMT).
vectors.provenance: RFC 0001 §4.7; RFC 0002 §4.2, §4.3; RFC 0001 §4.1 (start(in:) with nextValid and earlier); instants from SalahTimes' Python reference (SalahTimes 0.1.0, Vectors/reference/salahtimes_reference.py)
